# Hoffmann Audiology

> > Hoffmann Audiology is a comprehensive hearing care center in Irvine, Orange County, offering diagnostic audiological evaluations, hearing aid fitting and repair, tinnitus treatment, and pediatric hearing services led by Dr. Chris and Noel Hoffmann.

Located in Irvine, CA, Hoffmann Audiology provides full-spectrum audiology services including hearing tests, hearing aid evaluation and fitting, tinnitus management, and repair services. The practice features hearing aids from major manufacturers including Unitron, Signia, Oticon, Widex, Starkey, and Phonak, with specialization in Bluetooth-enabled and invisible hearing aid options.

- [Hearing Test Near Me | Diagnostic Audiological Evaluation Center in Irvine](https://hoffmannaudiology.com/diagnostic-audiologic-evaluation): Diagnostic hearing tests including pure tone, bone conduction, and speech recognition

- [Tinnitus Doctor Near Me | Tinnitus Test & Treatment in Irvine](https://hoffmannaudiology.com/tinnitus): Tinnitus assessment and treatment including retraining therapy with Dr. Hoffmann
